use_case.name: browser
use_case.title: browser: a real browser in a sandbox that sleeps
use_case.summary: A folder with an AGENTS.md, a .mcp.json and a page, deployed as a bundle together with the browser server's tool list (saved by running the server once at bundle build). The browser (rustwright-mcp behind a supergateway bridge) runs inside an E2B microVM that does not exist until the model first calls a browser tool, and is then paused and resumed; the grant names it as a connector that holds no standing stream.

tree.text:
---
model: gpt-5-mini
tools: tool_search
max-steps: 20
---

You operate a real web browser through the `browser` tools (reach them with `tool_search`). You have no
shell and no files. The browser runs on the same machine as the pages you are asked to open, so
`http://localhost:8000/` is a page on this machine.

- Use `browser_navigate` to open a page; its answer is an accessibility snapshot. Quote what you are
  asked about from the snapshot, never from memory.
- To type into a field, use `browser_snapshot` for its ref, then `browser_type` with that ref. A snapshot
  shows the page's title and the fields' contents.
- Keep answers to a few short lines.

Field Notes

A page served from inside the sandbox, for the browser to read.

stamp STAMP_PLACEHOLDER

  • first note
  • second note
  • third note

bundle.store: a private S3 bucket (beyond-ai-demo-demo-bundles-123456789012), fetched with a presigned link

checks.name: vm-created-on-first-tool
checks.title: The sandbox VM is created by the first sandbox tool call
checks.detail: no VM existed when the session opened, yet the model had the browser tools (from the list saved in the bundle); only when it first called a browser tool did the front make the VM (8882 ms after the session was ready), seed it, start the browser bridge and forward the call; the first browser result came 7576 ms after the call started

headline.label: first browser call to its result (VM made inside it)

checks.name: browser-reads-page
checks.title: The browser reads a page served inside the sandbox
checks.detail: navigate to the in-VM page plus its accessibility snapshot took 122 ms; the snapshot held the heading and this run's stamp (stamp-1024031907-725), and the reply quoted it. Browser tool calls with an empty-string optional argument so far: 0

checks.name: idle-cost
checks.title: What an idle browser costs
checks.detail: idle, with a page open: rustwright-mcp 1 MB anon, the bridge (node) 49.3 MB, Chromium (6 processes) 66.6 MB; 116.9 MB anonymous in all, of a 1982 MB VM

measurements.note: measured, not compared: no threshold is claimed

checks.name: state-survives-pause
checks.title: Page state survives a paused sandbox
checks.detail: after a 30 s pause the page still showed the line its own script had written when the text was typed (echo:M1426517926), read without navigating; resume took 303 ms and the first browser call after it 94 ms

checks.name: state-survives-idle-reap
checks.title: Page state survives the agent's MCP idle window
checks.detail: after 150 s idle (the agent's MCP idle window is 120 s) the page still showed what had been typed (echo:R1191610028), read without navigating, and the bridge saw no new initialize (1 before, 1 after): the connector was not reaped. Browser tool calls carrying an empty-string optional argument in this run: 0
